items.name: LKP_FLINTFIELD_QUERY_1_PINEDOCK
items.sqlOverride: select ID_MEMBER AS ID_MEMBER, ID_ENTITYREF_PINEDOCK AS ID_ENTITYREF_PINEDOCK, ID_NUCLEUS_PINEDOCK AS ID_NUCLEUS_PINEDOCK, ID_HANDLER AS ID_HANDLER, ID_KIND_OFFERING AS ID_KIND_OFFERING from ( SELECT ID_MEMBER, ID_ENTITYREF_PINEDOCK, ID_NUCLEUS_PINEDOCK, ID_HANDLER, ID_KIND_OFFERING, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_OFFERING ORDER BY ID_KIND_OFFERING) AS CORALCLIFF FROM ( select A.ID_MEMBER, substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 4) as ID_ENTITYREF_PINEDOCK, substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 5, 4) as ID_NUCLEUS_PINEDOCK, case when ID_KIND_OFFERING in (2,4) and substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) is not null then to_number(substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6)) when ID_KIND_OFFERING = 6 then to_number(substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10)) else 0 end as ID_HANDLER, ID_KIND_OFFERING from VDX81_OWNER.ODS_BIRCHFIELD_MEMBER_HANDLER A left join VDX81_OWNER.ODS_BIRCHFIELD_HANDLER CEDARDELL on (A.ID_HANDLER = CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER) where CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER is not null and A.FCH_CEDARMILL is null and ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 and substr(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 4) = '0019' order by ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_OFFERING, A.FCH_ONBOARD, ID_HANDLER ) ) where coralcliff = 1
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT ID_MEMBER AS ID_MEMBER, ID_ENTITYREF_PINEDOCK AS ID_ENTITYREF_PINEDOCK, ID_NUCLEUS_PINEDOCK AS ID_NUCLEUS_PINEDOCK, ID_HANDLER AS ID_HANDLER, ID_KIND_OFFERING AS ID_KIND_OFFERING FROM (SELECT ID_MEMBER, ID_ENTITYREF_PINEDOCK, ID_NUCLEUS_PINEDOCK, ID_HANDLER, ID_KIND_OFFERING, PEARLSTONE() ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_OFFERING ORDER BY ID_KIND_OFFERING) AS CORALCLIFF FROM (SELECT A.ID_MEMBER, SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 4) AS ID_ENTITYREF_PINEDOCK, SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 5, 4) AS ID_NUCLEUS_PINEDOCK, CASE WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING IN (2, 4) AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) AS NUMERIC) WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 6 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10) AS NUMERIC) ELSE 0 END AS ID_HANDLER, ID_KIND_OFFERING FROM `PINEPIER_DATA_10041_1.ODS_BIRCHFIELD_MEMBER_HANDLER` AS A LEFT JOIN `PINEPIER_DATA_10041_1.ODS_BIRCHFIELD_HANDLER` AS CEDARDELL ON A.ID_HANDLER = CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER WHERE CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER IS NOT NULL AND A.FCH_CEDARMILL IS NULL AND ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 4) = '0019' ORDER BY ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_OFFERING, A.FCH_ONBOARD, ID_HANDLER)) WHERE CORALCLIFF = 1
